title: [fortumblr007] Wan2.2 + 4step LoRA
description: Wan2.2 image-to-video with always-on LightX2V and selectable baked LoRA presets: assume_the_position, airblow, clothes_on_off, sudden_outfit_change, and tittdrop. Up to two presets per request. Each preset defaults to high weight 0.8 and low weight 0.7. clothes_on_off and sudden_outfit_change are high-noise only.
